## History

Prissy Andrews was a former student in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who later taught school in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). She was one of the older classmates present during Mr. Phillips's tenure as schoolmaster, taking part in the social life and events of the school standard. She eventually pursued her studies further, joining Miss Stacy's advanced class alongside her peers to prepare for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations.
